# Data Model: Admin Cloud Functions

**Feature**: `002-cloud-functions`
**Date**: 2026-04-15 (generated by `/speckit.plan` after the 2026-04-15 clarification pass)

This document is the authoritative field-level reference for every Firestore collection Spec 002 writes to. The entity descriptions in spec.md §Key Entities are the narrative view; this file is the lookup-table view.

No new collections. No new composite indexes. This spec only adds fields to three existing collections.

---

## 1. `jobs/{jobId}` — updated by 3 of the 5 functions

| Field | Type | Set by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string enum | `adminAssignJob`, `adminResolveDispute`, `adminCloseJob` | Allowed transitions in §1.1 below. Always `'completed'` (never `'force_closed'`) — FR-009, Principle V. |
| `assignedTechnicianId` | string | `adminAssignJob` | Same value written to `technicianId` for backward compat. |
| `technicianId` | string | `adminAssignJob` | Duplicate of `assignedTechnicianId`; retained to avoid breaking existing queries. |
| `assignedTechnicianName` | string | `adminAssignJob` | Server-sourced from `users/{technicianId}.fullName` — never accepted from client (research R-2). |
| `assignedBy` | string | `adminAssignJob` | `context.auth.uid`. **NEW FIELD** — whitelisted by FR-012. |
| `assignedAt` | Timestamp | `adminAssignJob` | `FieldValue.serverTimestamp()`. **NEW FIELD** — whitelisted by FR-012. |
| `disputeResolvedAt` | Timestamp | `adminResolveDispute` | **Reused** — existing field, name frozen by FR-019. |
| `resolvedBy` | string | `adminResolveDispute` | `context.auth.uid`. **NEW FIELD**. |
| `resolutionNote` | string | `adminResolveDispute` | Trimmed `reason` input. **NEW FIELD**. Never appears in `activity_log.description` (research R-12). |
| `receiptRejected` | boolean | `adminResolveDispute` (reopen branch only) | Set to `false` when resolving a dispute via reopen. |
| `amountPaid` | number | `adminResolveDispute` (complete branch), `adminCloseJob` | Finite, non-negative; `0` is valid. |
| `price` | number | `adminResolveDispute` (complete branch), `adminCloseJob` | Mirrors `amountPaid` (legacy alias). |
| `adminClosedAt` | Timestamp | `adminResolveDispute` (complete branch), `adminCloseJob` | **Reused** — existing field. `adminCloseJob` uses `null` check on this field as its idempotency guard (research R-3). |
| `adminClosedBy` | string | `adminCloseJob` | `context.auth.uid`. **NEW FIELD**. |
| `updatedAt` | Timestamp | all three | `FieldValue.serverTimestamp()`. Pre-existing field. |

### 1.1 Job status transitions (Spec 002 scope only)

| From | To | Function | Guard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requested` | `active` | `adminAssignJob` | Pre-existing status = `requested` (transaction snapshot). |
| `receipt_disputed` | `awaiting_customer_approval` | `adminResolveDispute` (reopen) | Pre-existing status = `receipt_disputed`. |
| `receipt_disputed` | `completed` | `adminResolveDispute` (complete) | Same guard. Also requires `overrideAmount` OR existing `price` to be non-null. |
| `receipt_disputed` | `cancelled` | `adminResolveDispute` (cancel) | Same guard. |
| `active` (or any non-terminal status) | `completed` | `adminCloseJob` | `adminClosedAt == null` AND (status not already closed) — idempotency guard inside transaction. Second call with `adminClosedAt != null` returns success with zero writes. |

Any other transition is a `failed-precondition`.

## 2. `payments/{paymentId}` — updated by 2 of the 5 functions

| Field | Type | Set by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum (`'PENDING'` / `'CONFIRMED'` / `'REJECTED'`) | `adminApprovePayment`, `adminRejectPayment` | Uppercase — confirm against `lib/firebase_service.dart` before writing (spec §Assumptions). |
| `reviewedBy` | string | both | `context.auth.uid`. **NEW FIELD**. |
| `reviewedAt` | Timestamp | both | `FieldValue.serverTimestamp()`. **NEW FIELD**. |
| `rejectionReason` | string | `adminRejectPayment` only | Trimmed `reason` input; MUST be non-empty after trim. **NEW FIELD**. Principle X: "a rejection without a reason must never reach Firestore." |

### 2.1 Payment status transitions

| From | To | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `PENDING` | `CONFIRMED` | `adminApprovePayment` |
| `PENDING` | `REJECTED` | `adminRejectPayment` |

Any other starting status → `failed-precondition`.

## 3. `activity_log/{autoId}` — written by ALL 5 functions

Immutable append-only collection. Firestore rule enforces `allow update, delete: if false`. Spec 002 only writes.

| Field | Type | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | Hard-coded per function | One of `job_assigned`, `payment_approved`, `payment_rejected`, `dispute_resolved`, `job_force_closed`. |
| `description` | string | **Fixed per-type template** (FR-003a) | See template table in §3.1. **Clarified 2026-04-15**: no user free-text interpolation. |
| `createdAt` | Timestamp | `FieldValue.serverTimestamp()` | Never `Date.now()` (Principle XI). |
| `userId` | string | `context.auth.uid` | Never from `data.*` (Principle XI). |
| `role` | string | Hard-coded `'admin'` | All writers in Spec 002 are admin. |
| `jobId` | string? | Input `jobId` where applicable | Present on `job_assigned`, `dispute_resolved`, `job_force_closed`. |
| `paymentId` | string? | Input `paymentId` where applicable | Present on `payment_approved`, `payment_rejected`. |
| `resolution` | string? | Input `resolution` | Present on `dispute_resolved` only (`'reopen'`/`'complete'`/`'cancel'`). |
| `reason` | string? | Trimmed `reason` input | Present on `payment_rejected` and `dispute_resolved`. Separated from `description` to keep free-text out of the primary display field (research R-12). |

### 3.1 Description templates (authoritative — Spec 005 depends on these verbatim)

| `type` | `description` template |
|---|---|
| `job_assigned` | `Admin assigned job {jobId} to {assignedTechnicianName}` |
| `payment_approved` | `Admin approved payment {paymentId}` |
| `payment_rejected` | `Admin rejected payment {paymentId}` |
| `dispute_resolved` | `Admin resolved dispute on job {jobId} ({resolution})` |
| `job_force_closed` | `Admin force-closed job {jobId}` |

Changing any of these strings is a breaking change for any downstream consumer that has pinned copy (notably the future Spec 005 Activity screen). Template formatter lives in `functions/src/lib/audit-templates.ts`.

---

## 4. `users/{uid}` — read-only in this spec

Read by:
- `verifyAdmin(context)` — reads `users/{context.auth.uid}` and checks `role == 'admin'` (research R-5).
- `adminAssignJob` — reads `users/{technicianId}.fullName` inside the transaction to get the server-authoritative display name (research R-2).

**Never written** by any Spec 002 function. If `users/{technicianId}` does not exist, `adminAssignJob` throws `HttpsError('not-found')` per FR-005.

---

## 5. Field-level sensitivity (feeds Security Review Gate row XIII)

| Collection.field | In logs? | In `description`? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payments.screenshotUrl` | ❌ Never (Principle XIII) | ❌ Never | Referenced only — never logged or displayed via audit. |
| `users.fullName` | ❌ Never | ✅ (as `assignedTechnicianName` via template) | The template puts it in `description`, which is one of the exceptions the Principle XIII enumeration permits — `fullName` is NOT in the forbidden list. |
| `activity_log.reason` | Only first 200 chars per FR-011 | ❌ Stored on its own field | Principle XIII truncation applies at the log boundary. |
| `context.auth.uid` | ✅ Allowed | Via template fields only | Admin UIDs are freely logged. |
| `context.auth.token.*` | ❌ Never | ❌ Never | Principle VIII prohibition. |
